records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Labs!
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for setting up Silver Labs on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invites, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:485bd112], [email:69a0185b]) — zero observed engagement signal. Starter plan, 8 days left. Accounts silent through day 6 with no project rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Following up on my note last week — I know a new tool is easy to park when the week gets busy.

If it helps, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. When you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through your first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
